local_repair_policy: Stop production on failed convergence or unresolved numerical gate; preserve point. No interpolation. Existing boundary solver only after a recorded local trigger.
policy_override_reason: User explicitly requests finite-dimensional Ritz maps and modal participation; no continuum root counting or root refinement at each point.

policy.benchmark_rule: 11 saved determinant points; three beta=0 points, three kappa=100 points, three exact RIGID controls. Reuse their Ritz results in maps.
policy.positive_definiteness: Existing diagonally scaled stiffness/mass SPD checks; no tolerance relaxation
policy.rationale: 1e-6 relative frequency and physical modal MAC convergence is sufficient for research figures; 36/44 and exact polynomial quadrature fixed in advance. Physical Rayleigh frequencies follow NSL-2 unchanged eigenvectors.
